about_the_game:
Hollow Floor is an atmospheric psychological horror set in a looping, scorched apartment. 

Trapped in a scorched apartment, you attempt to escape the unending hallways. However, you quickly discover there is no escape, and you aren't the only one trapped here.

  • Explore looping halls: Each loop reveals more of the past.

  • Retro graphics: Low-Poly Pixelated graphics evoke the feelings of the classics.

  • Tense sound design: Atmospheric soundscapes keep you on edge.

  • Surreal psychological horror: Dreamlike unsettling atmosphere.

  • Average play time: 30-60 minutes.
